[[File:Jewel_of_Yavin.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], a large gemstone.]]
'''Gemstone''' was a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] resource used in the construction of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and weapons. The [[Reinforced Insulated Sheath armor]] required gemstone.
